description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded firearm.

Area 15-foot burst within 60 feet

Duration until the start of your next turn

Saving Throw Reflex

An area-denial burst of gunfire that keeps enemies from advancing.

Empty your weapon into the area. Each enemy in it attempts a Reflex save against your class DC. On a failure it takes damage equal to one Strike's worth of your weapon's damage dice and cannot Stride toward you until the start of your next turn; on a critical failure it is also off-guard for that time.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
